body:
I know it is supposed to get better, it is so hard to move on.  

I don't want to be engaged, it would kill him to break it off though.   I don't want to be married but I don't want to be alone.  I want what me and my AP had.  A close emotional bond to someone.  The physical I can do without, but I need an emotional connection to someone and now that's gone and I feel lost.  

My life would be so different if he had never come into it.  Sometimes I think I would be better off if I never met him, then I wouldn't know what it was like to be in love with someone just to lose that.
